parsed.explanation: No criminalisation of trans identity, retained gender-reassignment discrimination protection, functioning courts and broad LGB social acceptance are genuine positives, with no documented police targeting or violence against trans visitors. But the dossier documents several tier-1 universal exposures with no demonstrated remedy: a statutory single-sex-spaces code in force (UN experts warn it institutionalises exclusion), strip-searching by birth sex, birth-sex custody placement after the prison guidance was struck down, and announced ward bans — plus a documented death following ward denial of cancer care. Surveys show recurring harassment in gendered spaces and a sharply hostile media climate. The legal challenge and regional divergence are unresolved open questions, not protections. Under rule 21 these unremedied universal exposures subtract through the band, placing the rating at the bottom of Elevated Risk despite no criminalisation.
